# TikTok Comments Scraper

The Apify actor [`clockworks/tiktok-comments-scraper`](https://apify.com/clockworks/tiktok-comments-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.476**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract TikTok comments. Just add a TikTok URL and get TikTok video and profile data: comments, URLs, numbers of shares, followers, hashtags, hearts, video, and music metadata. Export scraped data, run the scraper via API, schedule and monitor runs or integrate with other tools.

## Pricing

Pay per event — comment $0.00125 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/clockworks/tiktok-comments-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/clockworks-tiktok-comments-scraper@0.0.476#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `postURLs` | array |  |  | TikTok video URLs — Add the video URLs you want to extract comments from. Enter URLs one by one or edit it in bulk. |
| `commentsPerPost` | integer |  |  | Maximum comments (replies included) per post — The number of comments extracted from every result. Due to TikTok API limitations, the actual number of scraped comments may differ, especially for posts with thousands of comments. |
| `topLevelCommentsPerPost` | integer |  |  | Maximum top-level comments per post — The maximum number of top-level (non-reply) comments you want from a single post. |
| `maxRepliesPerComment` | integer |  |  | Maximum replies per comment — The maximum number of replies you want from a single comment. Note: Successful extraction of all desired replies is currently not guaranteed. |
| `profiles` | array |  |  | Usernames — Add one or multiple TikTok usernames you want to scrape. You can enter the usernames one by one, or use the Bulk edit section to add a prepared list. |
| `resultsPerPage` | integer |  | `1` | 💯 Number of videos per profile — Add the number of videos you want to scrape per profile. |
| `profileScrapeSections` | string[] |  | `["videos"]` | Profile sections to scrape — If a profile has reposted videos, you can scrape them by selecting Reposts |
| `profileSorting` | string |  | `"latest"` | Profile video sorting — Select Latest to scrape the most recent videos first, Oldest - the oldest videos first, Popular - the most popular videos first. Date filters only work with Latest and Oldest. Note: Popular sorting is limited by TikTok to approximately 400–500 videos per profile and may retur |
| `oldestPostDateUnified` | string |  |  | Scrape profile videos published after [date] — Optional filter. Only videos uploaded after or on this date will be scraped. Alternatively, specify how old the scraped videos should be in days. Putting 1 will get you only today's posts, 2 - yesterday's and today's, and so on. |
| `newestPostDate` | string |  |  | Scrape videos published before [date] — Optional filter. Only videos uploaded before or on this date will be scraped. |
| `excludePinnedPosts` | boolean |  | `false` | Exclude pinned posts — Tick to exclude pinned posts from profiles. Pinned posts are usually the first videos on a profile's page. |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cid` | string \| null | Unique identifier of the comment |
| `text` | string \| null | Text content of the comment |
| `createTime` | number \| null | Unix timestamp when the comment was posted |
| `createTimeISO` | string \| null | ISO 8601 formatted date and time the comment was posted |
| `diggCount` | number \| null | Number of likes the comment has received |
| `replyCommentTotal` | number \| null | Total number of replies to this comment |
| `uid` | string \| null | Unique identifier of the comment author |
| `uniqueId` | string \| null | Username (handle) of the comment author |
| `repliesToId` | string \| null | Comment ID this reply is directed to, if this is a reply |
| `avatarThumbnail` | string \| null | URL of the comment author's avatar thumbnail |
| `likedByAuthor` | boolean \| null | Whether the video author has liked this comment |
| `pinnedByAuthor` | boolean \| null | Whether the video author has pinned this comment |
| `mentions` | array \| null | Array of usernames mentioned in the comment |
| `detailedMentions` | array \| null | Detailed information about users mentioned in the comment |
| `images` | array \| null | Photos attached to the comment. URLs are signed and expire after about 30 days |
| `sticker` | object \| null | Sticker or GIF attached to the comment, if any. URLs are signed and expire after about 30 days |
| `videoWebUrl` | string \| null | URL of the TikTok video this comment belongs to |
| `submittedVideoUrl` | string \| null | The original input URL submitted to find comments for this video |
| `input` | string \| null | Original input value used to find this video |
